narrNote: South Dakota does not appear on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, reviewed 2026-10-22); SD DSS accredits substance use treatment agencies directly and no NARR state affiliate operates in South Dakota.
notes: Agency phone is the Division of Behavioral Health number published on the DSS Behavioral Health page. The Helpline Center operates both South Dakota 211 (211 has been accessible in SD since 2001; it is the state's only accredited Inform USA provider) and South Dakota's 988 line, in collaboration with SD DSS. SD publishes no standalone Medicaid SUD landing page: SUD treatment is covered under South Dakota Medicaid (including the section 1915(l) state plan option for SUD treatment in IMDs), so the DSS Substance Use Disorder services page is recorded under medicaidSud — it documents the statewide SUD service array and financial assistance, and the county map recorded under countyDirectory flags which treatment agencies in each county accept Medicaid. Face It TOGETHER is SD's stand-alone peer coaching organization (Sioux Falls HQ; coaches in Pierre and Watertown; virtual statewide) and is named by SD DSS as a peer support partner.
